headline: Tanzania Invites Investors to Gold Refining, Nickel and Copper Processing, Heavy Mineral Sands and Niobium as Mining Conference 2026 Opens
summary: At the opening of Mining Conference 2026, Tanzania invited investors into gold refining, nickel and copper processing, heavy mineral sands and niobium. Sixteen nickel and copper processing plants are under construction, and a nickel project agreement is due to be signed soon.
why: Tanzania is an African mining jurisdiction with gold, nickel and other metal resources, so downstream processing projects can affect global supply chains for these commodities and investment flows into the country.
